success_requirement: At least 45/50 PASS observed on physical phone (>=90%)
denominator_policy: Do not exclude failed/blocked attempts to inflate accuracy; report blocked and eligible population separately before computing overall gate.
repeat_policy: Exactly one explicit mic tap per attempt; no always-on wake. Restore each precondition before next attempt. No hidden cloud fallback or downloaded STT model.
voice_quality_note: Provider readiness and missing confidence may cause real-world failures; record observed outcome rather than assuming speech detection.
